nodes.name: Process Jobs One at a Time

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ {q_organization_domains_list: [$('Extract Posting Text').item.json.companyDomain], person_titles: ['HR Manager','Talent Acquisition','Recruiter','Hiring Manager','Team Lead','Engineering Manager'], per_page: 100} }}

parameters.jsCode: const base=$('Choose Unused Contact').item.json; const response=$json.data||$json; const status=String(response.status||'').toLowerCase(); const verified=status==='valid'; return [{json:{...base,emailVerified:verified,'Email Verification':status||'unknown',verificationReason:verified?'':'Hunter status must be exactly valid; accept-all, unknown, webmail, disposable, risky and invalid are rejected'}}];

const src=$('Build OpenAI Draft Request').item.json; let raw=$json.choices?.[0]?.message?.content??''; let p={}; try{p=JSON.parse(raw)}catch(e){p={body:String(raw)}}; return [{json:{...src,subject:String(p.subject||`Question about ${src['Job Title']}`),body:String(p.body||'').trim(),recipientEmail:src['Contact Email'],expectedEmail:src['Contact Email'],emailVerified:src.emailVerified===true,minWords:60,maxWords:120,mode:'INITIAL'}}];

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ {model:$env.OPENAI_MODEL||'gpt-4.1-mini',temperature:0.1,response_format:{type:'json_object'},messages:[{role:'system',content:'Repair the failed draft using ONLY the supplied applicant profile, actual job posting and recipient metadata. Do not add any skill, experience, education, metric, eligibility or company claim that is not explicitly present in the supplied source fields. Return strict JSON only: {"subject":"...","body":"..."}. Body must be 60-120 words, 3-5 sentences, exactly one question mark, include the exact title, one supported posting detail, both exact URLs and the required opt-out sentence. Do not leave placeholders.'},{role:'user',content:JSON.stringify({originalDraft:$('Draft Code Gate #1').item.json.body,failedChecks:$('Draft Code Gate #1').item.json.gateReasons,profileName:$('Build OpenAI Draft Request').item.json.profileName,profileBio:$('Build OpenAI Draft Request').item.json.profileBio,targetRoles:$('Build OpenAI Draft Request').item.json.profileRoles,locationPreference:$('Build OpenAI Draft Request').item.json.locationPreference,resumeUrl:$('Build OpenAI Draft Request').item.json.resumeUrl,portfolioUrl:$('Build OpenAI Draft Request').item.json.portfolioUrl,recipientName:$('Build OpenAI Draft Request').item.json['Contact Name'],recipientTitle:$('Build OpenAI Draft Request').item.json['Contact Title'],recipientEmail:$('Build OpenAI Draft Request').item.json['Contact Email'],company:$('Build OpenAI Draft Request').item.json.Company,jobTitle:$('Build OpenAI Draft Request').item.json['Job Title'],jobLink:$('Build OpenAI Draft Request').item.json['Job Link'],jobPostingText:$('Build OpenAI Draft Request').item.json['Posting Text']})}] } }}

parameters.jsCode: const previous=$('Draft Code Gate #1').item.json; let raw=$json.choices?.[0]?.message?.content||''; let p={}; try{p=JSON.parse(raw)}catch(e){p={body:raw,subject:''}}; return [{json:{...previous,subject:p.subject||previous.subject,body:p.body||'',recipientEmail:previous['Contact Email'],expectedEmail:previous['Contact Email'],emailVerified:previous.emailVerified,minWords:60,maxWords:120}}];

parameters.subject: ={{'[APPROVAL REQUIRED] '+$('Normalize Validated Draft').item.json.Company+' — '+$('Normalize Validated Draft').item.json['Job Title']}}
parameters.message:
={{'Review this cold-email draft.

Recruiter: '+$('Normalize Validated Draft').item.json['Contact Name']+' ('+$('Normalize Validated Draft').item.json['Contact Title']+')
Company: '+$('Normalize Validated Draft').item.json.Company+'
Job: '+$('Normalize Validated Draft').item.json['Job Title']+'
Job link: '+$('Normalize Validated Draft').item.json['Job Link']+'

DRAFT
To: '+$('Normalize Validated Draft').item.json['Contact Email']+'
Subject: '+$('Normalize Validated Draft').item.json.subject+'

'+$('Normalize Validated Draft').item.json.body+'

Approve: '+$execution.resumeUrl+'?decision=approve
Reject: '+$execution.resumeUrl+'?decision=reject

This link expires in 48 hours. The recruiter will not receive anything unless you approve.'}}

parameters.jsCode: const base=$('Build Approval Context').item.json; const resumed=$json; const decision=String(resumed.query?.decision??resumed.params?.decision??resumed.body?.decision??'').toLowerCase(); const approved=decision==='approve', rejected=decision==='reject'; return [{json:{...base,...resumed,approvalDecision:approved?'approved':rejected?'rejected':'timed_out',approved,jobStatus:approved?'Approved':rejected?'Rejected':'Timed Out',approvalTimestamp:new Date().toISOString()}}];

nodes.name: Update Job — Rejected or Timed Out

parameters.jsCode: const draft=$('Daily Cap + 3-Week Ramp Gate').item.json; const send=$json; const now=new Date(); const due=new Date(now.getTime()+10*86400000); return [{json:{'Job Link':draft['Job Link'],'Company':draft.Company,'Job Title':draft['Job Title'],'Status':'Sent','Contact Name':draft['Contact Name'],'Contact Title':draft['Contact Title'],'Contact Email':draft['Contact Email'],'LinkedIn URL':draft['LinkedIn URL'],'Email Verification':draft['Email Verification'],'Draft':draft.body,'Draft Subject':draft.subject,'Replied':'N','First Sent Date':now.toISOString(),'Follow-Up Due Date':due.toISOString().slice(0,10),'Follow-Up Sent Date':'','Follow-Up Draft':'','History':draft.history||'','Last Error':'','Approved At':draft.approvalTimestamp||now.toISOString(),'Approval Status':'Approved','Gmail Message ID':send.id||send.messageId||'','Gmail Thread ID':send.threadId||''}}];

const j=$('Build Sent Job Update').item.json; return [{json:{Email:j['Contact Email'],Name:j['Contact Name'],Title:j['Contact Title'],Company:j.Company,'LinkedIn URL':j['LinkedIn URL'],'Job Link':j['Job Link'],'First Seen':new Date().toISOString(),'Contacted At':j['First Sent Date'],'Contact State':'Contacted','Last Message Date':j['First Sent Date'],'Opted Out':'N','Gmail Thread ID':j['Gmail Thread ID']}}];

return [{json:{Timestamp:new Date().toISOString(),Workflow:'Main',Stage:'SCAN_COMPLETE',Outcome:'completed',Details:'Daily job discovery pass finished; item-level statuses are stored in Jobs.','Execution ID':$execution.id,'Message ID':''}}];
const j=$('Extract Posting Text').item.json; return [{json:{'Job Link':j['Job Link'],'Status':'Needs Human Review','Last Error':j.postingFailureReason||'Posting text unusable'}}];

const j=$('Choose Unused Contact').item.json; return [{json:{Email:j['Contact Email'],Name:j['Contact Name'],Title:j['Contact Title'],Company:j.Company,'LinkedIn URL':j['LinkedIn URL'],'Job Link':j['Job Link'],'First Seen':new Date().toISOString(),'Contacted At':'','Contact State':'Reserved','Last Message Date':'','Opted Out':'N','Gmail Thread ID':''}}];

const j=$('Email Verification Gate').item.json; return [{json:{'Job Link':j['Job Link'],'Status':'Needs Human Review','Email Verification':j['Email Verification'],'Last Error':j.verificationReason||'Email verification failed'}}];

const j=$('Choose Unused Contact').item.json; return [{json:{Email:j['Contact Email'],Name:j['Contact Name'],Title:j['Contact Title'],Company:j.Company,'LinkedIn URL':j['LinkedIn URL'],'Job Link':j['Job Link'],'Contact State':'Available','Opted Out':'N'}}];

const j=$('Normalize Validated Draft').item.json; return [{json:{'Job Link':j['Job Link'],'Status':'Pending Approval','Draft':j.body,'Draft Subject':j.subject,'Contact Name':j['Contact Name'],'Contact Title':j['Contact Title'],'Contact Email':j['Contact Email'],'LinkedIn URL':j['LinkedIn URL'],'Email Verification':j['Email Verification'],'History':j.history||'','Approval Status':'Pending'}}];
const j=$('Normalize Validated Draft').item.json; return [{json:{...j,approvalLinkGenerated:true}}];

const j=$('Normalize Approval Decision').item.json; return [{json:{'Job Link':j['Job Link'],'Status':j.approvalDecision==='rejected'?'Rejected':'Timed Out','Approval Status':j.approvalDecision,'Last Error':j.approvalDecision==='timed_out'?'No owner decision within 48 hours':''}}];
const j=$('Normalize Approval Decision').item.json; return [{json:{Email:j['Contact Email'],'Contact State':'Available'}}];

const j=$('Daily Cap + 3-Week Ramp Gate').item.json; return [{json:{Timestamp:new Date().toISOString(),Workflow:'Main',Stage:'SEND_RESERVED','Job Link':j['Job Link'],Company:j.Company,'Contact Email':j['Contact Email'],Outcome:'reserved',Details:`Daily cap ${j.dailyCap}; already reserved/sent today ${j.sendsToday}`, 'Execution ID':$execution.id,'Message ID':''}}];

const j=$('Daily Cap + 3-Week Ramp Gate').item.json; return [{json:{'Job Link':j['Job Link'],'Status':'Approved - Deferred','Approval Status':'Approved','Approved At':new Date().toISOString(),'Draft':j.body,'Draft Subject':j.subject,'Contact Email':j['Contact Email'],'Contact Name':j['Contact Name'],'Contact Title':j['Contact Title'],'Email Verification':j['Email Verification'],'History':j.history||''}}];

const j=$('Daily Cap + 3-Week Ramp Gate').item.json; return [{json:{Timestamp:new Date().toISOString(),Workflow:'Main',Stage:'SEND_DEFERRED', 'Job Link':j['Job Link'],Company:j.Company,'Contact Email':j['Contact Email'],Outcome:'deferred',Details:'Daily sending cap reached; approved draft retained for next daily queue','Execution ID':$execution.id,'Message ID':''}}];

const j=$('Build Sent Job Update').item.json; return [{json:{Timestamp:new Date().toISOString(),Workflow:'Main',Stage:'SEND_SUCCESS','Job Link':j['Job Link'],Company:j.Company,'Contact Email':j['Contact Email'],Outcome:'sent',Details:'Initial cold outreach sent after code gate and human approval','Execution ID':$execution.id,'Message ID':j['Gmail Message ID']||''}}];

parameters.jsCode: const j=$('Draft Code Gate #2').item.json; return [{json:{'Job Link':j['Job Link'],'Status':'Needs Human Fix','Last Error':(j.gateReasons||[]).join('; '),'Draft':j.body}}];
const j=$('Draft Code Gate #2').item.json; return [{json:{Email:j['Contact Email'],'Contact State':'Available'}}];
const j=$('Extract Posting Text').item.json; return [{json:{'Job Link':j['Job Link'],'Posting Text':j['Posting Text'],'Status':'Posting Fetched','Last Error':''}}];
